name: Formester Free Form Builder
free_limit: Unlimited hosted forms, fields and monthly responses on the Free plan, with AI form creation, custom email notifications, payment collection and quiz auto-scoring; 2 AI form generations per day and $0.25 in monthly AI credits.
watch_out: Free tier is positioned for individuals. Formester branding remains; conditional logic, backend-only forms, API access, team collaboration and advanced integrations require paid tiers. Commercial-use permission for this specific free plan is not explicitly confirmed; verify before production business use. Payment collection may incur processor charges.
